description: Local stdio MCP server for Polish public law and registers: 12 read-only tools, each running a public Apify Actor. Covers Sejm ELI legal acts, SAOS court judgments, EU-funds tenders, CEE public tenders, EIPA EV charging stations, CEPiK vehicle registration aggregates, GUNB building permits, ULDK land parcels with MPZP/POG zoning, RPWDL healthcare facilities, developer apartment prices and PSE electricity market data. tools/list works without a token; tools/call needs APIFY_TOKEN (pay-per-event).

notes: API key, requires APIFY_TOKEN (Apify API token from console.apify.com/settings/integrations, or a prepaid token from agi.apify.com). Without a token only tools/list works; tools/call returns a tool error.
